reasoning: The three angled vertical panels are the standard UI pictogram for a folded map, and secondarily a tri-fold brochure. It fits travel routing, offline map downloads, trail maps, and brochure design tasks well, though without a pin or route line it can occasionally be mistaken for a window or folding screen.
